snippet.title: Meow Box City - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Meow Box City on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/4000850

Meow Box City is a minimalist, multiplayer strategy game with a city-building theme based on a card deck.

Build your city piece by piece, expand your territories, control the board, and thwart your opponents’ plans while handling unexpected events.

As a game developed entirely from scratch by a small team of three, we are constantly working to improve it. If you have any feedback, questions, or issues regarding the game, please don’t hesitate to contact us.
